name: Chromatic-Infeasibility Framing
description: Replaces the explicit triangle definition (three workers with three incident files) with its chromatic equivalent: a subset of exactly three workers that cannot be validly 2-colored using only the edges among them. Models must deduce this implies the subset induces a K3, otherwise they will write an O(N^3) brute-force 2-coloring check which will TLE.
